# Full Stack AI Engineer

Remote·Full time·Remote

**Company:** Qubrid AI (McLean, Virginia, USA)
**Work Mode:** Work from Home \| **Type:** Full-time
**Experience:** 2–3 years of relevant experience

* * *

## Important Notes Before Applying

- **Work from home.**
- **Full-time role:** this position requires complete commitment. Candidates planning to work two or more jobs simultaneously, or seeking part-time work, **should not apply** — such applications will be automatically rejected.
- **Working hours:** late nights in India, until approximately **4 AM IST**, to overlap with US working hours. **Do not apply if this schedule does not work for you.**
- **Compensation:** depends on experience and current verifiable compensation (paychecks).
- **Experience:** candidates with **2–3 years** of relevant experience are suitable.

* * *

## About the Role

We are looking for a highly capable **Full Stack AI Engineer** to architect, build, and scale modern **SaaS platforms** and **production-ready AI-powered applications** from the ground up.

This role is for someone who has **real-world experience building complete SaaS products and implementing AI capabilities into production applications** — not just experimenting with models or building isolated frontend and backend features.

The ideal candidate understands how to design, develop, and ship scalable, production-grade applications across the full stack, including:

- Frontend systems and user experiences
- Backend APIs and microservices
- Databases and data architecture
- Authentication, authorization, and user management
- Billing, subscriptions, and usage-based systems
- Infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and cloud environments
- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture
- Applied AI systems, model integration, and AI-powered workflows
- AI model deployment, inference, and performance optimization

You will work closely with **product, design, AI, and infrastructure teams** to build reliable, scalable software products and practical AI solutions used in production environments.

* * *

## Responsibilities

### 1\. Full Stack Product Development

- Design and develop end-to-end SaaS applications from scratch
- Build responsive, scalable, and user-friendly frontend applications
- Develop secure backend APIs and microservices
- Implement authentication, authorization, RBAC, and user management systems
- Build billing, subscription, and usage-based systems
- Develop dashboards, admin panels, and workflow management systems
- Design scalable, multi-tenant application architectures

### 2\. Applied AI & AI Engineering

- Design, develop, and integrate practical **AI-powered features** into SaaS products and business applications
- Work with **open-source AI models** and deploy them in real-world production environments
- Integrate **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, embedding models, and other AI models into applications
- Build AI-powered workflows, intelligent automation systems, and **agent-based applications**
- Implement **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** pipelines, vector search, and knowledge-based AI applications
- Develop AI application pipelines involving document processing, data extraction, classification, summarization, and information retrieval
- Integrate AI models through APIs and **self-hosted inference** environments
- Work with model serving, inference optimization, prompt engineering, and context management
- Implement AI evaluation, output validation, monitoring, and reliability mechanisms
- Optimize AI applications for **latency, cost, scalability, and performance**
- Collaborate with AI and infrastructure teams to deploy and maintain production-grade AI systems

### 3\. Backend & API Engineering

- Design scalable backend architectures and APIs
- Build high-performance REST and/or GraphQL services
- **Must be an expert in Python**
- Demonstrate strong **Node.js** backend development expertise
- Implement asynchronous systems, queues, caching, and background jobs
- Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability
- Integrate third-party APIs and services
- Build secure, maintainable, and well-documented backend systems

### 4\. Database Engineering

- Design and manage scalable database systems
- Work extensively with:
  - **PostgreSQL**
  - **MongoDB**
  - SQL-based systems
- Design database schemas, indexing strategies, query optimization, and data models
- Build systems supporting high availability, backups, migrations, and scaling
- Work with **vector databases** and vector search technologies for AI-powered applications

### 5\. Infrastructure & Deployment

- Deploy and manage applications across cloud environments
- Work with:
  - **Docker**
  - **CI/CD pipelines**
  - Cloud infrastructure
  - Containerized deployments
  - AI model serving and inference infrastructure
- Build scalable production environments with monitoring and observability
- Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams on deployment strategies
- Understand the infrastructure requirements for deploying and scaling AI-powered applications

### 6\. Engineering & Product Ownership

- Write clean, maintainable, and production-grade code
- Participate in architecture and technical design discussions
- Write technical documentation and implementation plans
- Review code and maintain engineering best practices
- Collaborate cross-functionally to ship features quickly and reliably
- Take ownership of features from initial development through production deployment and maintenance

* * *

## Requirements

### Must-Have

- Strong experience building **complete SaaS platforms from scratch**
- Strong expertise in **Python** and **Node.js**
- Practical experience working with **open-source AI models**
- Experience building and deploying **AI-powered applications in real-world environments**
- Deep full-stack engineering experience across frontend and backend systems
- Strong experience with databases, including **PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL**, and SQL systems
- Experience designing **scalable multi-tenant SaaS architectures**
- Strong understanding of APIs, authentication systems, and application security
- Experience deploying and maintaining production systems in cloud environments
- Strong **JavaScript/TypeScript** and backend engineering skills
- Understanding of **LLM integration, AI application development, and model inference**
- Ability to take an AI capability or model and turn it into a **usable, scalable product feature**

### Preferred

- Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as **React** or **Next.js**
- Hands-on experience with LLMs, open-source foundation models, and embedding models
- Familiarity with **RAG architectures**, vector databases, and semantic search
- Experience building **AI agents**, intelligent automation, and multi-step AI workflows
- Experience with model serving frameworks and inference optimization
- Familiarity with **Redis**, queues, caching systems, and event-driven architectures
- Familiarity with **Kubernetes** and distributed systems
- Experience with **GPU-based AI workloads** or cloud GPU infrastructure
- Startup or high-growth product experience

* * *

## What We're Looking For

- Someone who has built **real SaaS products used by customers**
- Someone who has implemented and deployed **practical AI solutions**, beyond basic API integrations or experimental prototypes
- A strong product and systems-thinking mindset
- Ability to move quickly while maintaining engineering quality
- An ownership mentality with strong execution skills
- Someone comfortable working across the full stack **and AI application layer** without heavy supervision
- A problem-solver who can translate product requirements into reliable software and applied AI solutions
- Someone who understands that building production-ready AI products requires more than connecting an LLM API — it requires thoughtful engineering, integration, evaluation, optimization, and scalability

* * *
